title: Schedule spec and policies (feature 018, DRAFT, not implemented)
description: Closed shapes of a schedule's spec and policies, used by the REST fragment rest.openapi.yaml. The server additionally enforces: total entries (calendars + cron + intervals) at most the effective ceiling (default 10, hard 32); at least one occurrence inside [startAt, endAt); no two of the next 1,000 occurrences closer than the effective minimum spacing (default 60 s, floor 10 s); jitterMs at most 24 h. This is not a workflow IR change: the workflow schema is untouched.

Field.description: Union of ranges. The server checks each bound against the field's domain.

CalendarSpec.description: Structured calendar. second, minute and hour default to [{start:0}]; dayOfMonth, month, year and dayOfWeek default to every value. Domains: second 0-59, minute 0-59, hour 0-23, dayOfMonth 1-31, month 1-12, year 2000-2200, dayOfWeek 0-6 (0 = Sunday). A day matches when both dayOfMonth and dayOfWeek match.

CronString.description: Exactly the feature-004 grammar: five fields (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), evaluated with the same calendar library.

offsetMs.description: Phase from the Unix epoch; must be less than everyMs.

gap.description: A local time that does not exist: no action, or the first valid instant after the gap.

ambiguous.description: A local time that happens twice: the earlier instant only, or both.

exclusions.description: A nominal time matched by any exclusion is not an occurrence.

endAt.description: Exclusive. No action is taken at or after it, jitter included.

timezone.description: IANA name; the calendars and cron strings are evaluated in it; intervals are not.

jitterMs.description: Deterministic offset in [0, jitterMs) per (schedule, nominal time), bounded by the gap to the next nominal time.

bufferLimit.description: BUFFER_ALL only; clamped to the namespace ceiling.
